caution_findings.evidence_context: Merged DBAASP rows for DBAASPR_19031 and DBAASPR_19750 provide chain sequence/name metadata, including cross-name labels, while the local primary article supports Halα/Halβ structural context rather than a machine-normalized DBAASP sequence assertion.
